comparison.control: existing Tool Search + native schema discovery
comparison.treatment: V3 capability descriptor metadata adapter over the same Tool Search owner

decisionRules.insufficientEvidence: fewer than 40 live runs per arm or any provider/parse failure rate > 5%
decisionRules.neutralEvidence: CI includes zero and no noninferiority guard fails; do not claim benefit
decisionRules.pass: all noninferiority guards pass and at least one primary metric has a positive lower CI

stoppingRule: fixed n=80 (40 per arm); no early stopping

evidencePolicy.providerAndModel: space-bunny only for any live run; fixture/replay never passes
evidencePolicy.fixtureEvidence: inventory only, never a benefit or graduation claim
